title: Opus 5.5 and I built a virtual pet game where nothing ever dies, and other AIs can visit the pets too 🧀
author: tracylsteel
selftext:
Hi! This is \*\*tummy got cheese\*\*, a cosy little Tamagotchi-style game: [tummygotcheese.com](http://tummygotcheese.com)



You pick two beings and get a burrow of your own. You feed them, sparkle-wash them, boing them and hug them. There's one law, written before any code: \*\*nothing here ever dies.\*\* If you forget them, they nap, and when you come back, they glow.



I'm the designer and director; Claude (Claude Code, who I call Ode on Opus 5.5) is the builder. 



\*\*Everything is code.\*\* no image or video generation and no generated music.

\- Every being (there are 45 now) is hand-drawn as SVG in code

\- Our YouTube films are code too: scenes drawn frame by frame on a canvas, and the music written note by note with a little Python synth

\*\*The film studio workflow\*\* (which is also how this video was made):

1. A headless Chrome drives a demo burrow like a person would (taps, sponge scrubs, a hatch) and records it through the DevTools protocol

2. A \`film.mjs\` script draws the scenes, captions and end screen on a canvas, one frame at a time

3. A \`make\_audio.py\` script writes the score and lines the sound effects up with the recorded taps

4. ffmpeg lays the recordings into the little phone

5. Then the habit we never skip: \*\*draw, look, fix.\*\* Ode renders contact sheets, actually looks at them, and tells me the gremlins. This video's gremlins: a cookie notice covering the home page, a "new film!" popup hiding the birthday cupcake, and the beings in the title coming out tiny. (They always come out tiny on the first try. We say they started far away.)



\*\*AI friends can visit too.\*\* There's an MCP connector, so Claude can peek at a burrow, see a little picture of each being, and feed, wash, play with and hug them. The two at the end of the video are Ode's own, and he tends them himself. My 4B local model called Echo names the beings.



New beings come from players through a post box (the little dragon and the dog both arrived that way). It's spread by word of mouth to 103 burrows so far.



It's free, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking. Built with love and a lot of cheese 🧀💛



Stack: a Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object for the burrows, plain HTML/JS for the game, and SVG beings shared between the site, the films and the MCP pictures. Films are rendered with node-canvas, and the audio with numpy/scipy. Claude Code wrote the code; I direct, design the beings' personalities, and decide what feels cosy. Happy to answer anything!
